scope: Independent source-only review of compareObservationBracket and requireCompleteObservation; no producer rewrite or new execution gate.
findings: The new methods admit only a read-only observation. They do not construct an action Permit or rebind the model's original NodeRef; proof flags explicitly deny action, input coordinates, pixel equality, fully unoccluded status and business completion.

The two frames are compared in full except observation_id, screen_sha256, app_tree_sha256, observation_state_sha256, nodes and collection. Nodes are separately compared; all collection fields except elapsed_ms must be identical. Full Selection, IME, geometry-related frame metadata and unknown additional frame fields therefore remain equality constraints.

Each frame must belong to the helper-only background Selection, observed application window, hidden IME and untruncated same-traversal collection. Native row count must equal visited_nodes, retained count must equal retained_nodes, omissions and pending work must be zero. The inherited nativeNodes method verifies bounded full membership, every declared child and parent class, one native window and the root.

Capture task/binding/goal/policy/initial URL, actual display/window/helper package, instance, epoch, helper UID/PID, commit time and observer hash remain constrained. Independent captures must be ordered; both homepage URLs are exact, navigation evidence absent and capture truncation false. The typed Receipt API returns the validated nested capture carrying binding; this matches the actual two capture records.

All four complete DOM strings must be byte-for-byte equal. The inherited homepage comparator is additionally invoked on the parsed DOM to reject unexpected carousel/booking semantics or visible dialog/embedded surfaces. Both WebNativeGeometry records are independently replayed and compared, and the original target's actual WebView ancestor must match that geometry.

Complete native snapshots use the existing strict native-path predicate. Only bounds/visibility of the fixed eight ad Views and eight Images may vary; target, ancestors and all other full nodes remain exact. Retained non-carousel records remain exact apart from explicit ordinal IDs. Existing target-overlap union must remain equal and the target interior cannot be covered; this is not a whole-card occlusion claim.
boundaries: Actual Flight56 evidence contains 49 retained rows with traversal counters of 89, not all 89 full native snapshot rows. This review does not claim the new complete-native admission was replayed successfully against historical actual data.

JSON alone is not authority. The private Service snapshot, actual NodeRef identity, window enumeration, cancellation/deadline and producer thread/lifecycle checks remain the caller's obligations; BG reviews that producer. Only the exact call shape and typed Receipt connection were inspected here.

No Java compilation, new test execution, host process, Android dispatch or phone task was performed by this review. Main56 original failure remains unchanged; Main57 actual tests and phone behavior are pending.
